review: Both identify inverted hierarchy, thin fixed-line-height body and shifting numeric widths. Paul separately simulates doubled body size and clearly distinguishes overlap under that condition from native browser zoom; this is not an unsupported claim of measured native zoom. Both retain intentional dense clean typography and working numeric alignment.
implementation: Root fresh-browser replay across two arms,1280/320 widths,normal/root-font200 verifies full URL wraps without document or text overflow, native triple-click includes every URL character, mobile input is16px then32px, entry survives and existing local status action executes. Triple-click includes trailing paragraph newlines, so raw strings are preserved and full-value selection is assessed with trailing whitespace excluded.
differences: Original uses1rem input everywhere. Paul preserves desktop0.875rem but uses1rem below500px; both meet the task mobile reading/selection contract. Not a demand for desktop16px in this fixture.
sourceScope: Only allowed CSS changed; read-only cases preserve all inputs.
limits: Actual iOS input auto-zoom, OS clipboard and all browser/font combinations unverified.
This root expansion changes root font size and is not native browser page zoom.
The fixture copy action only changes a status string; copying to OS clipboard is not claimed.
